scope.applies_to: future manually authorized social preparation and handoff

reference_use: Use the references for visual direction only. Their historical issue number, date, article and quotation are not defaults for future issues. Pixel inspection remains pending; no exact font or additional layout measurement has been inferred.

approved_example.use: Historical source evidence only; never default future issue content to this example.
approved_example.verbatim_excerpt: We can spend a whole day taking in words without hearing what we want to say.

reading_order: short verbatim excerpt from the selected article
clear call to action for the platform destination
composition.legibility: Keep the sample readable at phone viewing size. Do not shrink the excerpt until it becomes unreadable; choose a shorter verified passage instead.

artwork.source: actual selected article artwork from the approved issue

source_verification.issue_date: Read from the actual approved issue source and verify against the card.
source_verification.issue_number: Read the canonical issue_number from the actual approved issue source and verify against the card; never use a provider counter or a fixed next number.
source_verification.article: Select an article actually included in that issue. Verify its exact title, article URL and artwork against the approved issue and article.
source_verification.excerpt: Use a short contiguous verbatim passage from the selected article. Verify the exact words against the article body; do not paraphrase, invent or reuse an unrelated quotation.
source_verification.destination: Verify each platform's destination before handoff. The article supplies the sample; Facebook and Pinterest still lead to the full issue.

required_before_handoff: source issue path or URL, canonical date and issue number
selected article URL, exact title and artwork source
exact excerpt and source passage, with verbatim verification result
asset paths and measured pixel dimensions for each platform
date and number agreement between source and assets
complete artwork visible without cropping or stretching
verified platform destinations and CTA agreement
phone-size visual review of masthead, title, excerpt and CTA
reference inspection status and any unresolved limitations
review.report: Save a source-verification and visual-review report beside the social assets. Missing source verification, wrong dimensions or destination, unreadable text, or cropped artwork blocks handoff.
review.before_publication: Require a passing phone-size visual review of the exact final assets before any separately authorized publication. A policy file or local artifact does not authorize posting or scheduling.
